My tears run down Love does not turn away
My blood runs down My tears run down
I bore the price that day
I hope you never feel what I feel
When the earth is filled with violence
When rivers of tears and blood run dry
ជ្រងើ្តែត្តខឹងសង់រហើលស្នៅមានសាស់បានោះពេល្រីទៀតាើបត្រាប់បានជាលាធាស់ប់តាលន្នាប់ច្ចុំថ្រទៀត្រាប់នៅការ

You forsake me, forsake me
Why forsake me?
Why forsake me?
This sorrow will not rise again
and this ruin must not remain
love will purge what love must purge
death cannot reign
i take no pleasure in what must be done
no pleasure at all
evil will not hold forever

Purging sorrows and fears
I am come down, not divided in my heart
Love that bled for you, now takes man's kingdoms apart
I am home
